map.：P=1/f=1/0.5=2D（200 度）。近视片为负屈光度、远视片为正。: P = 1/f = 1/0.5 = 2D (200 degrees). Myopia lenses are negative power and hyperopia lenses positive.
map.：P=1/(−0.5)=−2D；物在无穷远成像于视网膜前 0.5m 处。: P = 1/(-0.5) = -2D; the object at infinity images 0.5 m in front of the retina.
